THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
BLUE & GOLD
029
36 / Black Velvet
Straight light brown hair with a soft center part, pale blue
eyes, light freckles, nude lips and small gold drop earrings. A
black velvet jacket with sculpted puff shoulders and
fabric-covered buttons sits over a fine black ribbed turtleneck,
against a blurred cream runway.
37 / Infinity Print
Very long, straight honey-blonde hair with a center part,
pale blue eyes and warm terracotta lips. An aubergine
peasant-style top with a ruffled neckline and a repeating
lilac-and-white knot motif is layered with a long gold chain and a
beaded tassel pendant, in front of a blurred red and yellow
backdrop.
